note: Vectors for the rules of contract 4.7, made by reference/tabproto.py. Colours are 0xRRGGBB as integers. 'linear' is the table of lum(): every side holds a copy and compares it bit for bit. 'mix': [a, b, p, mix(a, b, p)]; 'mix_halves': for each weight in use, every pair of channel values [a, b, out] where a * (100 - p) + b * p ends in exactly 50. 'blend': blend(a, b, 0.82) per channel, at every exact half and at every pair where a fused multiply-add may give another value. 'themes': the page themes the vectors use, in device form; 'styles': the card styles. 'card': card_colours() for a theme and a style of those, a tint, on and lit, with the card's tokens ion, onbg_pr and bg. 'image': image_look() for a card of a theme without a style (null: not drawn). 'label': label_size() before the width is checked; 'smaller' are the sizes to try in turn while the text is wider than the rectangle. 'clock': clock_text(). 'slider': amounts and values under a finger ([x, y, amount, value]; value null: nothing is sent, for a slider whose track has no length or whose max is not above min), and slider_shape() for values, as distances from the start edge along the axis. 'track': track_pieces(). 'choice': choice_cells() from the rectangle's corner, null when nothing is drawn, and the option under a point (null: none). 'steps': linePoints and the steps' rectangles. 'bars': the colour of each bar with mark.
